steps: Rinse the dalia and moong dal together and leave them in water for 20 to 30 minutes.
Heat the ghee in a pressure cooker and let the cumin and hing sizzle.
Fry the onion, ginger and green chilli until the onion is soft.
Add the tomato, turmeric and salt and cook until mushy.
Stir in the carrot, potato, peas and chilli powder for a minute.
Drain the dalia and dal and stir them in for two minutes.
Pour in about four times as much water and pressure cook for 2 to 3 whistles.
Let the pressure drop on its own, loosen with hot water if needed, and serve warm.
note: All three sources cook the dalia with moong dal, so it is added. Sources use 27 to 80 g of dalia a person; 50 g plus the dal makes a full breakfast bowl. The vegetables are kept small because they bulk up the bowl.
